description: This file defines a sales register report for ERPNext, including functions to fetch invoice data, compute income, tax, and unrealized profit/loss details, and generate report columns and data.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to run the sales register report, calling internal _execute with filters.

methods.name: _execute
methods.description: Fetches invoice data, computes totals, and prepares report data and columns based on filters and additional columns.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Generates report column definitions dynamically based on invoice data and additional columns.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL WHERE conditions based on provided filters for querying invoices.

methods.name: get_invoices
methods.description: Retrieves list of invoices matching filters, with optional additional query columns.

methods.name: get_invoice_income_map
methods.description: Creates a mapping of invoice IDs to income account amounts.

methods.name: get_internal_invoice_map
methods.description: Creates a mapping of invoice IDs to unrealized profit/loss amounts for internal customers.

methods.name: get_invoice_tax_map
methods.description: Creates mappings for tax amounts and updates income account totals.

methods.name: get_invoice_so_dn_map
methods.description: Maps invoices to sales orders and delivery notes.

methods.name: get_invoice_cc_wh_map
methods.description: Maps invoices to cost centers and warehouses.

methods.name: get_mode_of_payments
methods.description: Retrieves payment modes used in invoices.
